newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU opens tender for export 100,000 T durum wheat.
newsitem.headline: EU opens tender for export 100,000 T durum wheat.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday opened a tender for the export of 100,000 tonnes of EU free-market durum wheat to countries outside the EU, EU grain officials said.

The tender will start on December 5, they said. Industry sources said the European Union was hoping for indications on the value of European durum wheat on world markets from the export offers that may be submitted at the tender.
In some parts of the EU durum wheat prices are currently 30-40 percent above intervention prices despite prospects of a bumper crop.
But trade sources said the decision to export EU durum wheat was likely to put upwards pressure on domestic prices.
